title: Tron
card: Cadence brains play strong games: ride a light cycle against a deep brain and watch every neuron settle on its move.
tagline: Light cycles against a brain that sees the whole arena
feature: A deep Cadence brain sees the whole arena and settles on every move in your browser, in real time. Alone it beat a bot that looks one move ahead in 102 of 128 games; a look-ahead over the rules checks its moves.
howTo: Press Space or tap to ride; steer with the arrows, WASD or a swipe. Watch the brain settle on each move: an amber arc marks a move the look-ahead overruled. Point at a neuron to see what it tracks. BRAIN ALONE removes the look-ahead.
